lines.p_gena_1: Lyokha, come in. Gena here. Recording check: platform, switch, crossing. Every metre.
lines.p_gena_2: Moscow won't take our word for it. I want to see the rails are still there.
lines.p_gena2: Further east. Film where the rails end, too. They're cutting them out there, the bastards.
lines.p_bell: …The crossing? There's been no power here since ninety-one.
lines.c1_gena_morning: Morning, Lyokha. How was the night? Tape goes in the box on the platform. Railcar at noon.
lines.c1_zina_1: Why are you standing at the empty house, watchman?
lines.c1_zina_2: A granny lives here. Polya. She waved to me from the window last night.
lines.c1_zina_3: What Polya? Nobody's lived there for five years. Look how grey the boards are.
lines.c1_gena_box: Tape in the box. Batteries in the evening. Don't hand it in — you sit in the dark.
lines.c1_gena_paid: Got it? Batteries and a clean tape. Fair and square, Lyokha. Keep filming.
lines.c1_gena_angry: Didn't hand it in? Suit yourself. Moscow won't pay me without film, and I won't pay you.
lines.c1_zakhar_1: Watchman… Did you film last night? Show me later.
lines.c1_zakhar_2: At ten in the evening I announce the rules. Over the loudspeaker. Listen to the end.
lines.c1_zakhar_3: And stay in the dispatch room until the crossing rings. The board will tell you where it is.
lines.rule_n2_0: Attention. Yelovy station speaking. Rules for the night.
lines.rule_n2_1: One. When you hear the bell, don't run on the platform.
lines.rule_n2_2: Two. Whoever walks to the train — wake them. Take them by the shoulder and hold until they come to. Don't shout.
lines.rule_n2_3: Three. Don't hide in the empty carriage at the dead end. It isn't for you.
lines.rule_n2_4: Four. Don't touch the bell on the platform. It calls the train.
lines.vika_rule_1: And my rule: if it stops right in front of you — don't get on. Even if Mum calls.
lines.vika_rule_2: Mum's in Norilsk. That's up north. It goes there, right?
lines.n2_zakhar_1: Dispatch, come in. I'm at the board. Three-oh-nine. Waiting.
lines.n2_zakhar_2: It's ringing. It's coming. The lamps along the line are lighting up: third kilometre, second…
lines.n2_zakhar_3: It's stopped at the platform. Someone's coming out of the houses. Wake them, watchman.
lines.n2_zakhar_4: It's leaving. Into the dead end, where the buffer is. Lord…
lines.n2_zakhar_switch: It went onto the siding! It's standing. You've got a minute, maybe a minute and a half.
lines.woke_petrovich: What… Where am I? I was asleep. Zina…
lines.woke_petrovich_f: Point that light away. I'm going home. I'm going home.
lines.woke_zina: Oh. I'm in my nightgown… on the platform?
lines.woke_zina_f: Don't film me like this. I'm going home.
lines.woke_vika: It was standing there. Standing with its door facing me…
lines.woke_vika_f: Did you film me? For Mum? …I’ll go.
lines.c1_morning_lost_1: Watchman. Do you remember who lived in the house by the pump? Neither do I. But there are two cups on the table.
lines.c1_morning_lost_2: Tape. Rewatch what was recorded last night.
lines.c1_morning_saved_1: Everyone is home. Everyone I remember. Rewatch your tape, watchman. Now.
lines.c1_morning_saved_2: Tape. Rewatch what was recorded last night.
lines.end1_1: Lyokha, tape in the box. Every morning. Got it?
lines.end1_2: Don't hand them in, watchman. Hear me? Don't hand in the tapes.
lines.talk_zakhar: The board lights up without power. Don't ask me, watchman.
lines.talk_vika: Will you film me? For Mum. She's in Norilsk.
lines.talk_petrovich: Ghost train? Ha. Gena's telling you stories to keep you awake.
lines.talk_zina: Petrovich is sitting by the crossing again. Don't listen to him.
lines.int_zakhar_1: I've been at this station since fifty-two. Station duty officer.
lines.int_zakhar_2: I used to announce trains. Now I announce… rules.
lines.int_zakhar_3: No. Not about fifty-three. Turn it off.
lines.int_vika_1: Hi Mum. It's me, Vika. It'll snow soon here.
lines.int_vika_2: Granny's ill. I'm doing well at school. Almost.
lines.int_vika_3: Will you come? Or I'll come myself. There's a train here. Going north.
lines.int_petrovich_1: Glotov, Viktor Palych, tractor driver! Former.
lines.int_petrovich_2: Film away, film away. Show Zinka how handsome I am.
lines.int_petrovich_3: The branch is dead, watchman. They cut the rails — and good. Nobody should walk here.
lines.int_zina_2: Vitya drinks because he's scared. Since ninety-one.
lines.int_zina_3: The crossing rang back then too. And then Savva was gone. And nobody remembers him but me.
lines.proto_n1: New here? Come on, I'll show you.
lines.proto_n2: The road to the village — that way, past the crossing. Walk it in daylight.
lines.proto_c1: You came, watchman. Shut the door — there's a draught.
lines.proto_c2: I'm handing over the shift. The board knows where the train is. You just watch.
lines.proto_c3: Keep the camera with you. What the eyes can't see — the film can.
lines.proto_c4: That's it. You're the one on duty now, and I…
lines.proto_c5: Don't open it. That's not for us.
lines.proto_c6: Zakhar Ilyich… someone's standing on the tracks.
